'''sweigold You should have profited''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[sweigold]]
* '''Published:''' 21 December 2001 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|You Can Either Profit By This...|EJP-L-youcaneitherprofitbythis.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' You Can Either Profit By This...
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PTat Profit sweigold LS 2001 GPN.txt |Download]]
